answer: A payout is split and therefore 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The lantern schedule is applied in mirror and lotus reveals each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3261 identities would post 2793 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
